title: E0085: Inline PHP execution short tags
plain_english: Short echo tags (`<?= ?>`) and short open tags (`<?`) can cause portability issues. In environments where `short_open_tag` is disabled, code may break or be served as plain text.
why_matters: Short tags can cause: - PHP source code to be served as plain text if `short_open_tag` is disabled - Portability issues across different server configurations - Confusion with XML declarations (`<?xml ... ?>`)
what_it_checks: `<?= ... ?>` short echo tags in PHP files
